_comment: The goal race and the training block built around it. All values are examples. Override the date with VITE_RACE_DATE. The goal tiers below are illustrative round numbers, not anyone's real targets.
_goalsComment: Three tiers, because one target is either too soft to train against or too brittle to race against. Coach trains to the realistic tier; the A-goal is auditioned at tune-up races; the floor is what still counts as a good day.

goals.label: A-goal · stretch
goals.note: Audition it at the tune-up races. Earn it, do not assume it.

goals.label: Realistic · target
goals.note: What Coach trains toward. Every marathon-pace session anchors here.

goals.label: Floor · safe result
goals.note: The safety net if race day goes sideways. Still a good day.

_photoStripComment: Optional. The photo strip on the public page. Ships null so the whole section hides, because the images it wants live in dashboard/public/media/ and .gitignore excludes image files wholesale, so no fork inherits anyone's photos. Set the four strings and drop your own images in to turn it on.

_photoStripShape.eyebrow: Small label above the heading, e.g. Cross-training
_photoStripShape.heading: The line that carries it, e.g. Race weekend, earlier this month.
_photoStripShape.aside: Handwritten-style note to the right, e.g. legs still remember it.
_photoStripShape.caption: Footer credit under the strip

_planRevisionComment: Optional. Coach's most recent plan-revision note, rendered as a banner on the training page. Ships null so the banner hides. Write it as plain prose about the training decision, never with real biometric readings in it: this string is inlined into the client bundle, and it renders on the public page too if you enable one.

_planRevisionShape.tag: Two or three words for the chip, e.g. speed block
_planRevisionShape.body: What changed and why, in a sentence or two.
